reviews.review:
--This is not great. 
--Reading values of face cards is hard. For some reason they replaced AKQJ cards with pirate symbols like a crosshairs or whatever... except I have no idea whether the crosshairs is supposed to be a J or an A, so it's miserable guessing at a glance whether I have a straight or not. The game also renamed hands for no reason, so a upgrade for "Kraken" hands is for flushes.
--For roguelike poker, Balatro is vastly better.  Among other things, it doesn't ask you to check a reference guide each time you forget what hand a "Harpoon" or a "Kraken" is supposed to be. 
--Some really basic stuff is missing like auto-sort. (You need to click a button after each draw to sort your hand). 
--The pirate music is not great for extended gameplay... which is kind of a hallmark of roguelike games. The pirate theme in general does not feel like a big plus here. 
--No interesting roguelike upgrades or decisions in 20 minutes. Pass
